senses.definition: n.pr.loc. in Benj., mentioned with לֹד and אוֹנוֹ Ezr 2:33 = Ne 7:37; with these and other places Ne 11:34; prob. = Ἀδιδά 1 Macc 12:38, Ἀδίδοις 13:13; mod. El-Ḥadite c. 3 1/4 miles N. of E. from Lydda, GuérinJudée i. 320 (cf. RobBR iii. 143).
